feeds.title: This Ain't The Lyceum Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kelly Mantoan! I'm a Catholic wife, mother, homeschooler, and special needs parent who started blogging in 2012 to document some of the funny and poignant moments. When I'm not blogging, I might be working on a book, educating my kids, piling more dishes in the sink, driving someone to practice, or running out to Applebees for a drink with my husband.

feeds.title: Eucharistic Motherhood
feeds.description: I'm Kathryn Rombs, Ph.D., Catholic wife and mother of six (amazing) children. I am captivated by motherhood as an extraordinary, fulfilling, Christ-like vocation.

feeds.title: Spiritual Woman
feeds.description: Patrice is a writer, artist, and homeschooling mom. Here you will find musings on life, readings, and a relationship with God.

feeds.title: FranciscanMom
feeds.description: Living as a Secular Franciscan wife and mom. I'm an editor at CatholicMom.com, a contributing writer for Today's Catholic Teacher, and a member of the Catholic Writers Guild. I'm also a homemaker, freelance writer/editor, reader of cookbooks, and (very) amateur musician.

feeds.title: Graceful Blog
feeds.description: A Catholic homemaking blog for young, married women. Graceful Catholic is a place where they aspire to help ladies simplify their homes, excel in their vocation, and obtain the peace of soul that comes with clarity in the Catholic faith.

feeds.title: Catholic Icing Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Lacy and I run Catholic Icing, a site devoted to bringing Catholic crafts and activities to Catholic kids, embracing amazing Catholic Culture by icing your Catholic Cake with all of these yummy extras!

feeds.title: Emily Jaminet
feeds.description: I'm Emily, a wife, a mom, a writer, a speaker. I'm also a Catholic woman who is looking to find meaning and purpose in my vocation as a wife and mother with 7 children who take up a whole lot of time and energy. I seek out the face of Christ in my day- to-day life and call on his PERFECT mother for help.

feeds.title: Not So Formulaic Blog
feeds.description: I'm Ginny - wife to Dan and mom to three great kiddos. I'm passionately Catholic, a Gifted and Twice Exceptional advocate, and a former high school English teacher turned homeschooling mom. Let's pursue the true, the good, and the beautiful as we break down stereotypes.

feeds.title: Catholic Moms Group Blog
feeds.description: We act as a catalyst, guide, and mentor to parishes wishing to launch a Catholic mother's ministry to support the moms in their community.

feeds.title: Karen Edmisten
feeds.description: Karen Edmisten is a Catholic convert, writer, and mom who shares her faith journey and family life. She writes about prayer, homeschooling, dealing with loss, and finding God in everyday moments. Her blog is warm, personal, and encouraging.

feeds.title: Equipping Catholic Families
feeds.description: Celebrating Catholic Family and Faith with crafts, Catechesis, and traditions! I am a wife, mom of 5 kids, an author, and a crafter. We offer beautifully designed, authentic Catholic teaching tools, captivating the attention of children and providing quality resources for parents and all educators in the Catholic Faith.

feeds.title: Daily Graces
feeds.description: Kate Taliaferro is an Air Force wife, mom of 5 under 9. She enjoys homeschooling, crafting, and reading books one sentence at a time. She has a Masters in Religious Education and tries to find God's presence in all parts of her day, be it cooking, cleaning or just the everyday ordinary. Follow her blog, Daily Graces to join her crazy, adventurous, God-filled family.

feeds.title: Catholic Nursing Mothers League
feeds.description: The Catholic Nursing Mothers League is a ministry that provides encouragement and resources for Catholic breastfeeding mothers.

feeds.title: A Catholic Mom Climbing the Pillars
feeds.description: A Catholic wife and mom, master catechist, and former homeschooling mom of 8 years constantly climbing the Pillars of fire and truth which is the Catholic church. Always reading, she loves reviewing books, conducting book discussions, and writing.

feeds.title: Holy and Healthy Catholic Blog
feeds.description: Lori Crock, the author of Holy and Healthy Catholic is a parishioner at St. Joseph Catholic Church in Plain City, Ohio. She enjoys being active in her parish as a Eucharistic Minister, Adoration Ministry Coordinator, and Walking with Purpose participant. The Holy Spirit has inspired Lori to speak about faith and fitness and she humbly welcomes these opportunities for sharing and connection to other faith-filled women.

feeds.title: Grams Ramblings
feeds.description: I am a proud mother of nine wonderful children, grandmother of twenty four and great grandmother of two - an ever growing family and I love them all. Faith,Family, Friends, Freedom, Fun, Food - all important things to me. It shows in my writing, I'm sure.

feeds.title: Happy Catholic
feeds.description: Happy Catholic is the personal blog of Julie Davis, known for her honest, often witty reflections on everyday Catholic life. She shares quotes, art, book and movie thoughts, and short spiritual insights highlighting how faith shows up in ordinary moments, sometimes in surprising or humorous ways.

feeds.title: The Young Catholic Woman Blog
feeds.description: The Young Catholic Woman is a blog started by Carolyn to support young women in their faith. It shares honest posts about life struggles, healing, beauty, friendship, and spiritual growth. The blog encourages women to ask questions, use their gifts, and stay close to God. It's a welcoming space where faith and real life come together.

feeds.title: Association Of Catholic Women Bloggers
feeds.description: Association Of Catholic Bloggers is a site dedicated to sharing a variety of views from Catholic Women Bloggers who are faithful to the teachings of the church.

feeds.title: A Catholic Moms Life Blog
feeds.description: A Catholic Mom's Life is a blog by Heather Johnson, a mom of five. She shares family traditions, recipes, prayers, and tips to help other moms live their faith at home. Her posts are friendly and practical, showing simple ways to bring Catholic life into everyday family routines.

feeds.title: CatholicMom Blog
feeds.description: Catholic mom blogs are written by mothers who share faith, family life, and everyday experiences through a Catholic lens. Some focus on practical tips and planners, while others highlight family traditions, recipes, and liturgical living. Larger platforms like CatholicMom.com feature many writers offering reflections, prayers, and parenting advice.

feeds.title: Catholic Finer Femininity Blog
feeds.description: Catholic Finer Femininity is a blog by Leane VanderPutten, a Catholic wife, mom, and grandmother. She shares old-fashioned wisdom about faith, family, marriage, and womanhood. The blog includes her own thoughts and also writings from traditional Catholic authors.

feeds.title: Traditional Catholic Femininity Blog
feeds.description: Traditional Catholic Femininity is a digital platform and brand, offering a 360 Traditional Catholic lifestyle experience for traditional Catholic girls and women. My main goals and vision for Traditional Catholic Femininity are to provide support, to inspire and be inspired by Traditional Catholic women of all ages in their vocations, as well as to promote Marian virtues, Biblical femininity, Godly womanhood, and traditional, old-fashioned values.

feeds.title: Catholic Girls Forever Blog
feeds.description: Catholic Girls Forever is a blog by Therese Harrity created especially for Catholic girls primarily teens and young adults. It offers uplifting content like monthly challenges, excerpts from Girls, You're Important, and Poems and Prayers to inspire and encourage readers.

feeds.title: Catholic Country Chronicles Blog
feeds.description: Catholic Country Chronicles is a blog run by two sisters, Leah and Abby, who share Catholic faith stories from their rural farm life. Rooted in their country upbringing, they write heartfelt 'chronicles' to help readers connect the Gospel with everyday life. The blog includes reflections on spirituality, liturgical living, personal growth, relationships, and prayer, as well as extra resources like prayer printables and reading recommendations.

feeds.title: The Ember Collective Blog
feeds.description: The Ember Journal is a Catholic magazine for women that comes out a few times a year. It shares faith reflections, healthy recipes, home projects, and simple living ideas. The goal is to help women care for their body, mind, and soul while living with faith.

feeds.title: Catholic Faith Corner Blog
feeds.description: I'm Mary, a Roman Catholic. I'm a Sister of Notre Dame, of Chardon, Ohio.The Sisters of Notre Dame are apostolic women religious whose mission is to proclaim God's goodness and provident care through lives of service. We are dedicated to education in all its forms. We minister in a variety of areas including religious education, social justice, pastoral ministries, health care, and social service.

feeds.title: Prayer Wine Chocolate Blog
feeds.description: Prayer Wine Chocolate is a Catholic blog that blends prayer, friendship, and joy. It began with Rosary nights where friends gathered over wine and chocolate. The blog shares faith reflections, adoption stories, gift ideas, and prayer journaling tips. It also inspires women to host their own retreats or gatherings that combine prayer with community and fun.

feeds.title: Integrated Catholic Woman Blog
feeds.description: Integrated Catholic Woman is a blog and community run by Betsy, a Catholic health and wellness coach. Her goal is to help women take care of their body, mind, and soul together all connected to their Catholic faith.

feeds.title: Catholic Women Disciples Blog
feeds.description: Catholic video creator, Digital writer, Author

feeds.title: Shower of Roses Blog
feeds.description: Shower of Roses is a warm and creative Catholic blog run by Jessica Gordon. She joyfully shares how her family celebrates faith through traditions, crafts, holiday ideas, and lessons tied to saints like St. Catherine and St. Therese. Posts include fun, faith-based projects like Advent book baskets, Saint costume parties, papal unit studies for kids, and meaningful prayers inspired by liturgical seasons.

feeds.title: Kathryn Whitaker Blog
feeds.description: In this space, Kathryn shares openly and honestly about making mistakes, reaching out for advice (sometimes while hiding in her closet), finding God in the details, planning some parties, organizing your corner of the world and praying God fills in the gaps when she has a less-than-stellar day. Kathryn is the mom of six - college to elementary school - wife to one amazing man and an author and speaker.

feeds.title: Reconciled to You Blog
feeds.description: Sharing the Catholic faith through books, conversation, and laughter, as it is experienced in everyday life!

feeds.title: Blessed Catholic Mom Blog
feeds.description: Simple resources to help you grow in faith one step at a time. I am Mary: a Catholic woman and researcher of ways to make life easier and bring more joy and peace to each day. My goal is to provide practical ideas and encouragement to help you as a mom nurture your Catholic faith so you may live with more joy and peace.

feeds.title: Inspire the Faith Blog
feeds.description: Michele Faehnle and Emily Jaminet are the co-authors of the award-winning bestseller Divine Mercy for Moms, and The Friendship Project. They are also proud members of the elite Catholic Speakers Organization. As Jesus sent out his disciples two by two to preach the Good News, Michele and Emily have also taken Christ's commissioning to heart with the help of the Holy Spirit. Check out the blog to learn and know more.

feeds.title: Catholic All Year Blog
feeds.description: Hi. I'm Kendra. I am a catholic wife and mother of seven. I also dabble in teaching, reading, writing, cooking, baking, homeschooling, and leading a catholic life. This blog is a place for me to share how we live.

feeds.title: Christine Lacayo Blog
feeds.description: On content writing tips, multicultural marketing, environmental topics, and Catholic-faith inspiration and how it relates to entrepreneurship and care for the creation of life.

feeds.title: A blog for my mom
feeds.description: I'm Rosie! Catholic mom of seven. Learn along with me as I raise Catholic kids, dabble in homeschooling, discover the joys of parenting twins, and laugh at toddler antics!

feeds.title: Retro Mummy Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Corrie, and live with my gorgeous husband and 7 beautiful children on a couple of acres. I'm Catholic. I consider being a mum my vocation. I started blogging to share my knitting projects and a bit of family life since I was going to be at home with a new baby. I've learned a lot over the years and love to share our family life and all of my craft and baking projects with you all.

feeds.title: Nobody Puts Mama In A Corner!
feeds.description: Mama Holli, a catholic mom, welcomes you to her perky, crazy, and happy world where Nobody Puts Mama In A Corner! Find Mama's recipes, photography, and art.

feeds.title: Day by Day with María
feeds.description: Blog reflections by a Catholic author and journalist about living out her Catholic faith day by day.

feeds.title: Sarah Damm
feeds.description: I am a Catholic wife, mom, writer, reader, and knitter. I am a wife to Greg and mom to six children, ages 6 to 14. I spend my days like many moms - running errands, helping with homework, and cooking meals, but I am the first to admit that I don't love to cook. Greg and I strive to weave our faith into our daily routines as well as our traditions and celebrations.

feeds.title: Everyday Catholic Woman Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Everyday Catholic Woman. Please think of this title as simply a description of who Margie is. Margie's goal is to talk about living a Christian life, in practical everyday terms. The title, Everyday Catholic Woman, is meant to give you an idea of Margie's perspective.

feeds.title: Wildflowers and Marbles
feeds.description: I'm Jennifer Mackintosh, and I'm a Catholic home educator, finding the simple joys in living here in the beautiful foothills of the Appalachian Mountains. Sharing the beauty found in the ordinary moments - planning, organizing, homeschooling, and living the Catholic faith.

feeds.title: Oklahoma Catholic Women's Conference Blog
feeds.description: We want to encourage the Catholic women of Oklahoma to continue strengthening their faith long after our conference has ended. Our blog is one way we do that. The Oklahoma Women's Conference began in 2008 by a small group of dedicated women who had a vision of bringing together hundreds of women for a single day of fellowship and deepening their Catholic faith.

feeds.title: Snoring Scholar
feeds.description: I'm Sarah - Catholic convert, wife, mom, reader, and writer. Join me as I chronicle my reading, random observations, and share the things that catch my eye, all while chasing kids and chugging coffee.

feeds.title: Heidi Saxton
feeds.description: Covers articles primarily about prayer and sharing PrayerStories, how God is at work in our lives. Heidi Saxton writes for Catholic writers, road warriors, and the sandwich generation.

feeds.title: Mothering Spirit
feeds.description: I'm Laura Kelly Fanucci. Mother, writer, wonderer. This space is where I explore mothering through writing. It's where I celebrate how God shows up in the chaos of raising children. It's where I love to build community with readers like you.

feeds.title: Single Mom Smiling Blog
feeds.description: Single Mom Smiling is a blog by Kerri Lynn Bishop, a Catholic mom of five who was left by her husband while she was pregnant. She writes honestly about the struggles of being a single mom like handling emotions, money, and raising kids while leaning on her faith. Her posts and podcast give encouragement, hope, and practical tips to help other single moms find peace, strength, and joy again.

feeds.title: Just Another Catholic Girl Blog
feeds.description: Just Another Catholic Girl is a personal Catholic blog by Nora Hopkins, where she shares honest reflections on everyday life rooted in faith. Her content is warm and relatable, covering topics like trust, relationships, identity, and spiritual growth in a straightforward, down to earth style.

feeds.title: Modern Catholic Mom Blog
feeds.description: My name is Moira. I love faith, food, family, fashion, and friends. I hope this blog will encourage you to embrace your own, crazy amazing life and to let go of everything that the world is telling you that you should be, so you can become the woman that was meant to be.

feeds.title: A Catholic Newbie Blog
feeds.description: This blog is run by a Catholic convert who shares her experiences and reflections related to Catholic faith and spirituality. The blog covers topics like conversion, prayer, sacraments, and Catholic culture.

feeds.title: Blessed Is She Blog
feeds.description: Blessed is She is a sisterhood of women who want to grow together in their Catholic faith. We create beautiful and accessible resources, products, and experiences to foster community and deepen faith, both online and in person.

feeds.title: The Natural Catholic Mom
feeds.description: My name is Mariette, and I am excited to share my Faith, family, and pursuits in natural living with you here! I am passionate about my Catholic Faith and am especially devoted to the Traditional Latin Mass. Slowly we are trying to build up our home, our domestic church, to be a place where we grow not only in health, but most importantly, holiness.

feeds.title: Kimberly Cook
feeds.description: I am a blogger, freelance writer, published author, and Catholic apologist. Check out my latest articles about my journey into the New Feminism! I hope you are moved and challenged by these articles and posts, and that together we can grow stronger in Christ!
